title: 皐月賞の後に・メラメラなんばーわん

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon fails to seize victory in the Satsuki Sho and must give up center stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She shakes off her frustration and takes the stage with a big smile on her face, where she feels her dream taking on a clear shape.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next time, she vows to win and take center stage at a dirt race that, like the Satsuki Sho, can only be entered in classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next goal is the Japan Dirt Derby, one of the few classic-year G1 races on dirt.
